{{Quote|You won't get away with betraying the Republic, Doctor Tarnis.''"<br />"''The name is Lord Tarnis. I've shed that old skin.|Tarnis and the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tracking Down the Traitor|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
'''Tarnis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The son of the legendary [[Darth Angral]], Tarnis was [[Sith training|trained]] by his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Praven]] to the rank of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord before embarking on an undercover assignment not long after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the Great Galactic War. Posing as the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] '''Eli Tarnis''', he infiltrated the Republic's [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] projects and quickly became the head of the design team for the [[Planet Prison]] weapon on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While his initial purpose was to gather information from inside the Republic, Tarnis believed his cover was in danger in [[3643 BBY]] when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] arrived on Coruscant to investigate a "dark presence" the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had sensed on the capital. He made his move and attempted to steal the Planet Prison with the help of the criminal organizations known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].

Staging his own [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] after hiring a [[Vistis Garn|thief]] to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|steal]] the design files for the Planet Prison, Tarnis fled to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]], but was pursued by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]. Tarnis' true identity was uncovered by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], working with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], and the Sith was followed to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where the Knight and Carsen faced the Sith Lord in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] in order to stop him from using the Planet Prison against Coruscant itself. Tarnis' [[Death/Legends|death]] was witnessed via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] by his father, who declared everlasting vengeance upon his son's killer and embarked on a [[Desolator crisis|crusade]] to gain revenge upon the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|A Sith, working as my chief scientist! How can I defend the Republic if I can't trust my own people? [...] I've known that team for years. I never saw a hint they were anything less than patriots.|General Suthra on Tarnis's skill in infiltrating the Republic|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
[[File:Angralhead.png|thumb|right|130px|Darth Angral, Tarnis's father]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Tarnis was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] the son of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> sometime during or before the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> Found to have inherited his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]],<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> he was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblooded]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Praven]]<ref name="Desert Duel" />&mdash;one of his father's own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]]. Tarnis ascended to the rank of Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] sometime before the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> in [[3653 BBY]], when his father led an invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to capture the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> and Tarnis' teacher joined<ref name="Praven">{{TORcite|type=codex|Praven (Knight)}}</ref> [[Darth Malgus]] and Lord [[Adraas]] in destroying the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Deceived" />

When [[Darth Baras]] negotiated the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and ended the Great Galactic War, Angral was furious to be denied the chance to crush the Republic once and for all.<ref name="Threat of Peace 1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> Tarnis inherited his father's hatred of the Republic as well, and was sent undercover on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by Angral as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] not long after the treaty.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> The man put his scientific genius to use as part of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]]'s [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] projects, where Tarnis and other scientists worked<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> to weaponize technologies developed by the brilliant [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] during the war.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Architect of Annihilation|Taris}}</ref> As Doctor "Eli Tarnis," it was not long before the Sith became the chief scientist for the entire division during the tense [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and while he did contribute significantly to the other designs such as the [[Shock Drum]] and the [[Death Mark laser]], he worked primarily on the [[Planet Prison]]&mdash;a weapon designed to [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionize]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] entire [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], preventing any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from leaving or entering the atmosphere and effectively [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] a planet without any additional [[Navy/Legends|naval]] firepower.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> However, Tarnis also developed a way to combine the different weapons into something he called the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]], though he kept his research a secret.<ref name="Desolator">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Desolator Superweapon}}</ref>

===Deception===
{{Quote|Tarnis! We risked everything for you. Stealing those data files, faking your kidnapping&hellip; this is how you repay us?''"<br />"''You were compensated with enough weapons and armor to make Black Sun invincible.|Salarr and Tarnis|<ref name="Rescue" />}}
[[File:Eli_Tarnis.png|thumb|left|160px|Doctor "Eli Tarnis"]]
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Planet Prison was reaching the prototype stage, and the scientists were preparing to start trials when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] arrived on Coruscant to investigate a darkness that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sensed on the capital.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> Fearing that his cover would soon be exposed, Tarnis set in motion a plan to seize control of the Planet Prison and escape from Republic territory.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Contacting the criminal syndicate known as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], Tarnis revealed his true identity as a Sith Lord and made an offer to [[Salarr]], Black Sun's leader. In exchange for advanced weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Rescue" /> from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], acquired through Tarnis's allies in the Imperial-friendly [[Justicars' Brigade]] paramilitary group,<ref name="A Diverting Assignment">{{TORcite|type=general|A Diverting Assignment|Coruscant}}</ref> Black Sun would aid Tarnis in the elaborate deception he was about to perpetrate.<ref name="Rescue" /> At Tarnis's request, Black Sun enlisted the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Vistis Garn]]&mdash;who often worked for Black Sun's rival, the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]&mdash;to steal the design files for the Republic superweapons. A team of Guild members under Garn's leadership [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|raided]] a [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|military warehouse]] and stole a shipment of heavy weapons in addition to the design files Tarnis had requested.<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref>

Just over thirty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later,<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Tarnis was summoned to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] for a meeting with General Suthra and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters [[Orgus Din]] and Bela Kiwiiks, as well as Kiwiiks' [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Kira Carsen]]. Kiwiiks was concerned that Tarnis seemed to not care about the missing files, and the Doctor was irritated that the Jedi were against the development of the Planet Prison&mdash;it was a humane defensive weapon. Not long into the conversation, Din's [[Hero of Tython|former student]] arrived, and General Suthra departed the [[Conference Room 2-Aurek|conference room]] with the two Jedi Masters for a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] when the Mon Calamari's subordinate [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] arrived with news:<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> A member of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], Galen and his team had identified Garn as one of the thieves and tracked him to the [[Old Galactic Market]], a region under the control of the Merchants' Guild.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

While Carsen worked with Galen to distract the criminals with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] security network, Din's apprentice&mdash;a recently elevated [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;traveled to the Old Galactic Market with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] in order to recover the weapons and plans. While the duo [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|raided]] the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] where Garn was holed up,<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Tarnis contacted Black Sun and set the second stage of his plan in motion. Taking advantage of the preoccupation of Suthra and Galen's forces, Tarnis gave a Black Sun team inside information on the Senate Building's defenses so that they could sneak inside and [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|"kidnap" him]]. The plan worked perfectly, and Tarnis disappeared from the building before security realized the criminals were there.<ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:Tarnis_holo_hood.png|thumb|right|160px|Tarnis used Salarr's men for his own ends.]]
The Black Sun criminals retreated to the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] in order to serve as a distraction, while Tarnis himself took an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]]&mdash;but instead of going to the [[Black Sun territory|gang's territory]] as planned,<ref name="Kidnapped!" /> he traveled to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the Justicars so that he could prepare for the third stage of his plans.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> While the Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]] and his men fought the Coruscant Security Force in [[Docking Bay 84]] to protect their "prize,"<ref name="Kidnapped!" /> Tarnis transmitted a secure message to the five other members of the Planet Prison design team. He informed his subordinates that the Jedi had discovered the project and were planning to shut it down, convincing them that the only way to save the project was to bring him the prototype deep in the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]]. Believing their superior, the five stole the prototype from their [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] and journeyed deep into the region to meet with Tarnis at the [[Justicars' Tower]].<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Knight had joined forces with Carsen to [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|break through]] the kidnappers' lines and learned from Zeer that Tarnis had been taken to Black Sun Territory. General Suthra was alarmed to discover that the files stolen by Garn had contained information on all of the Republic's weapons projects, and so Masters Din and Kiwiiks departed Coruscant along with Agent Galen to secure each offworld facility.<ref name="Kidnapped!" /> Galen had first put the Knight in contact with the CSF's [[Special tactical unit|Special Tactical Unit]], and the Jedi had traveled deep into Black Sun Territory with T7-O1 to meet up with the [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. The Knight and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]]'s men staged their [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|attack]] on [[Black Sun Headquarters|Salarr's headquarters]] and quickly broke through the criminals' defenses, causing the Black Sun leader to contact Tarnis in a fury. Tarnis brushed off Salarr's accusations of treachery and ordered the criminal to kill the Knight, who had just entered the room and discovered the "Doctor" talking to Salarr via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]]. When the Jedi accused him of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], Tarnis revealed his true identity as a Sith Lord before terminating the conversation<ref name="Rescue" /> so that he could meet with his design team.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

===Deception at an end===
{{Quote|I'm departing Coruscant now, Father. The Planet Prison deploys in minutes. The Republic will have no choice but to surrender.''"<br />"''You return to me as a hero of the Empire, my son. Our victory is complete.|Darth Angral congratulates his son|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
[[File:Tarnis_Sadic_Holo.png|thumb|left|200px|Tarnis prepares to battle the Knight.]]
The five scientists gratefully handed control of the prototype over to Tarnis, but were horrified when their superior turned on them and drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], unleashing [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] from his fingertips as he [[Death/Legends|cut them down]]. The Sith Lord made quick work of the defenseless scientists, though one man&mdash;[[Jonkan]]&mdash;was only wounded mortally and witnessed the Sith depart with the prototype.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> Tarnis descended into the industrial sector known as [[The Works/Legends|the Works]], where he was escorted to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and began to set up the Planet Prison in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|chambers]] of the Jedi Council.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Jonkan managed to hold on long enough for the Jedi Knight to arrive with Carsen, and in his last moments explained that the device needed time to charge&mdash;and that it generated immense amounts of heat. Using the scientist's information, the two Jedi were able to locate the weapon in the Jedi Temple and raced to the ruins, cutting through the Imperials who attempted to stop them.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

As he waited for the device to charge, Tarnis contacted his father via a secure [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]]<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> threaded through [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and several other planets,<ref name="New Intelligence">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|New Intelligence|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and informed both Angral and his father's three apprentices&mdash;[[Sadic]], Praven, and [[Nefarid]]&mdash;of his success. Angral was greatly pleased by his son's accomplishments, and was in the process of praising Tarnis when the Knight and Carsen stormed into the room. Sadic mocked Tarnis for leaving loose ends, but Angral urged his son not to allow the Jedi to stop their victory. Refusing the Knight's offer of surrender, Tarnis summoned his [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed lightsaber to his hand and unleashed a storm of violet lightning at the two Jedi before charging. Though Tarnis was skilled with his blade and in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], he was ultimately no match for the younger Jedi's martial skill and strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and their [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] ended when the Knight struck down the Sith Lord before the unbelieving [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of Tarnis's father.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Jedi filth&hellip; you've killed my son! You've no idea what you've unleashed, Jedi. There's no place in the galaxy to hide from my wrath.|Darth Angral|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
Tarnis's death drove his father to the brink of insanity, and Angral [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] upon the Republic in his effort to exact revenge upon the Jedi Knight who killed his son. Seizing control of the Republic's superweapon projects,<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> Angral used his son's research on combining superweapon technologies&mdash;Tarnis's final gift to his father&mdash;to combine the stolen weapons into the planet-killing Desolator.<ref name="New Intelligence" /> After successfully [[Devastation of Uphrades|testing]] the weapon on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Uphrades]],<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|the ''Daybreaker''}}</ref> Angral attempted to destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], but the Knight was able to [[Battle of the Oppressor|defeat]] the elder Sith Lord aboared his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], ending the threat of the Desolator forever.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref>

When Praven faced the Knight on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he understood that the Jedi's power was what ultimately led to his student's death, and the Sith was satisfied to know that his training had not been at fault.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> Tarnis's work on the Planet Prison would later be adapted into the weapons known as the [[Firestorm Turbolaser]]s by Imperial scientists during the [[Battle of Corellia]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="Firestorm">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Firestorm|Corellia}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I have no time for this nonsense. Finish your pointless battle. Coruscant's fate is already sealed.|Tarnis|<ref name="Rescue" />}}
A Human male with green eyes<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> like his father's,<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" /> Tarnis had brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and pale skin in his mild-mannered "Eli Tarnis" persona. However, when Tarnis dropped the facade, the power of the dark side visibly darkened and grayed his skin, and he wore a dark hooded [[Clothing/Legends|cloak]]. Tarnis was an arrogant and cruel man, and some of it bled through his disguise in that he was considered stuffy and self-important as a scientist.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> As a Sith Lord and the son of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral, he believed himself invincible and trusted fully in the power of the dark side to destroy his enemies and ensure his victory.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> Once he no longer had need of allies like Salarr, Black Sun,<ref name="Rescue" /> and even his research team,<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> he cast them aside and continued his own plans with complete confidence that he would succeed. His arrogance stemmed from both his brilliance and his strength in the dark side, and Tarnis was willing to use both to achieve his objectives.<ref name="Rescue" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Channel your rage, my son. Don't let this Jedi steal your moment of triumph.''"<br />"''Your blood flows through my veins, Father. I cannot fail.|Darth Angral and Tarnis|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
[[File:Tarnis_Lightning.png|thumb|right|190px|Tarnis was skilled in the use of Force lightning.]]
As the son of the powerful Sith Lord Darth Angral, Tarnis inherited his father's strength in the Force<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> and was trained by Praven as a Sith.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> In battle, Tarnis wielded a single red-bladed lightsaber with considerable skill, but relied more upon his use of Force blasts and lightning.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> The Sith's true skills lay in subterfuge, as Tarnis was skilled enough to maintain his cover for almost a decade,<ref name="Rescue" /> and in science&mdash;the man was a genius. Tarnis's work brought significant advancements to the superweapon projects,<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> and he also developed a way to combine the Shock Drum, Death Mark laser, and Planet Prison weapons into a single ship-mounted weapon&mdash;a feat that even the renowned Doctor [[Nasan Godera]], the creator of those weapon technologies, acknowledged as pure brilliance.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarnis first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The ultimate antagonist of the Coruscant section of the Prologue for the Jedi Knight class,<ref name="Rescue" /> he is first encountered as "Doctor Eli Tarnis" in the mission "The Jedi Envoy."<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> Tarnis is the target of the missions "Kidnapped!," "Rescue," "Tracking Down the Traitor," and "Race to the Ruins," though his identity as a Sith Lord is not revealed until the end of "Rescue".<ref name="Rescue" /> When the player faces Tarnis in the Jedi Temple, they can choose to ask him to surrender for light side points or attack for dark side points, but regardless of the player's choice they will fight and kill Tarnis.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

In the game's [[2015]] digital expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], Tarnis appears in the hallucination scenes of Chapter 2 as an enemy for players, who take the role of the "[[Alliance Commander|Outlander]]," of the Jedi Knight class.<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref>
